title: Releases
unreleasedSub: Everything changed since the last release, by you or Studio AI.

blockedTip: Fix {n} error first | Fix {n} error first | Fix {n} errors first

emptySub: Edit a page or ask Studio AI, and changes collect here until you release them.
structureShips: Structure ships, records stay: releases move pages, schemas, functions and settings. Records, files, queue messages and run history never move between environments.

migrationsN: {n} generated migration | {n} generated migration | {n} generated migrations

provisioningN: {n} storage change | {n} storage change | {n} storage changes
noProvisioning: no buckets or folders to create
deployHint: {env} switches to the new definition in seconds. You can roll back at any time.
recordsStay: Records are not copied. {env} keeps its own records, files, queue messages and run history.
approvalNeeded: Production needs approval from an Owner or Admin. The release is created now and waits for their approval.

canClose: You can close this — the deployment keeps running.
approvalRequestedHint: An Owner or Admin can approve it from the Production card. Nothing changes in Production until then.
rollbackDesc: Switches the environment back to an earlier version.
deploymentDesc: Validate, migrate, provision and switch — step by step.
rollbackAdmins: Only an Owner or Admin can roll back Production
noChangeDetail: No change details recorded for this version
rollbackBody: {env} stops running {from} and switches back to {name}. The switch takes seconds.
rollbackRecords: Records, files and run history in {env} stay as they are. Columns added by later migrations are kept but unused.
